description: Stable local media for Notion image blocks, keyed by Notion blockId. Applied at build time so a re-pull cannot reintroduce expiring signed URLs or drop alt text. origin=notion-original means the file was downloaded from Notion; origin=replacement means the original was unavailable and a faithful diagram was redrawn from the surrounding note text.

342d3a21-bb2d-8070-a6de-d48ee9bfe45b.alt: Savitch's recursion: a path from u to v of at most t steps is split at an intermediate node m into halves of at most floor(t/2) and ceil(t/2) steps, recursing to depth log t.
342d3a21-bb2d-8070-a6de-d48ee9bfe45b.note: Original Notion upload unavailable to the ingestion integration (HTTP 404); redrawn from the note's reachable_within_t_steps pseudocode.
342d3a21-bb2d-8070-a6de-d48ee9bfe45b.caption: Diagram redrawn in September 2026 from the surrounding text; the original image was no longer retrievable.

35617c95-99fd-8027-910e-d331f53c777d.alt: Without Intel Hyper-Threading one thread runs on a core holding one architectural state; with Hyper-Threading two threads share one core that holds two architectural states.

35417c95-99fd-809e-8ba4-cc2b887aef0c.alt: Layered UNIX structure: users, then shells, compilers and system libraries, then the system-call interface, the kernel (file system, CPU scheduling, virtual memory, drivers), the kernel-hardware interface, and hardware controllers.

3b717c95-99fd-80a7-ac4b-c83a8bc9b455.alt: Memory regions of a C++ program from top to bottom: stack for function calls and local variables, heap for dynamic allocation, static storage for global and static variables, and code (text) for compiled instructions.

3b7d3a21-bb2d-8052-9492-d19a0a4dea6f.alt: Two boxes: int x at address 0x1000 holds 42; the separate pointer variable p at address 0x2000 holds 0x1000 and points to x.
3b7d3a21-bb2d-8052-9492-d19a0a4dea6f.note: Original Notion upload unavailable to the ingestion integration (HTTP 404); redrawn from the note's 'a pointer is also a box' explanation.
3b7d3a21-bb2d-8052-9492-d19a0a4dea6f.caption: Diagram redrawn in September 2026 from the surrounding text; the original image was no longer retrievable.

3b7d3a21-bb2d-8009-a921-d5ae92bdca4e.alt: Typical C process memory layout from high to low addresses: stack growing down, unmapped gap, heap growing up, BSS, data, and read-only text segment.
3b7d3a21-bb2d-8009-a921-d5ae92bdca4e.note: Original Notion upload unavailable to the ingestion integration (HTTP 404); redrawn from the note's list of memory segments.
